title: POV: You Earn Less Than Your Friend, But You're Never Broke

lines: Jake earns fifty five hundred a month. You earn thirty five hundred.
scenes.img: split scene, a young man in a blue shirt in a fancy apartment on the left, {HERO} in a cozy small apartment on the right, vertical composition

lines: It's the twenty eighth, and Jake is texting you for two hundred dollars.
scenes.img: a young man in a blue shirt pacing at night texting on his phone, worried, vertical composition

lines: You used to be broke on day twenty six too. Every month.
scenes.img: {HERO} at a grocery checkout looking stressed at his phone, vertical composition

lines: So you found your leaks. Food delivery, forgotten subscriptions. A hundred fifty a month.
scenes.img: a doorstep piled with food delivery bags, {HERO} opening the door surprised, vertical composition

lines: Then you paid yourself first. Five hundred dollars, automatically, every payday.
scenes.img: {HERO} looking at a phone with a green check mark savings transfer, relaxed on a couch, vertical composition

lines: A starter fund first. Then one full month ahead.
scenes.img: {HERO} jumping with joy in his living room holding his phone, confetti, vertical composition

lines: Now your bills get paid with last month's money. Payday isn't a rescue anymore.
scenes.img: {HERO} calmly drinking tea at a kitchen table looking at a savings app, morning light, vertical composition

lines: Jake earns more. You're the calm one. The full story is on my channel.
scenes.img: {HERO} walking confidently down a sunny street, a young man in a blue shirt stressed on his phone in the background, vertical composition
